get_timeline_posts.description: Extract posts from the current X timeline using the anti-click-wrap pattern.

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to extract.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll rounds to load more timeline posts, default 5, max 20.

returns.description: Array of post objects with text, author, and timestamp.
Array of user info objects.

search_posts.description: Search X posts by keyword and extract the search result list (top or latest).

maxItems.description: Maximum number of posts to return, default 20, max 100.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll rounds to load more search results, default 5, max 20.

returns.description: Object with ok, query, mode, url, resultCount and items array.

get_trends.description: Read the current trending topics from the X Explore page.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of trends to return, default 20, max 50.

returns.description: Object with ok, url, trendCount and trends array.

get_post.description: Open an X post detail page and extract author, text, media, metrics and canonical URL.

returns.description: Object with ok, id, canonicalUrl, author, publishedAt, text, images, videos, cards and metrics.

get_article.description: Open an X Article (long-form post) and extract title, author, body blocks and images. Accepts an article URL or a post URL that shares an article.

url.description: X article URL or a post URL that links to an article.

returns.description: Object with ok, articleId, title, author, publishedAt, contentText, blocks and images.

get_thread.description: Open any post in an X thread and extract all posts in the author's thread in order. The root is inferred from the conversation timeline, so any post URL works.

url.description: Any post URL in the thread, e.g. https://x.com/<user>/status/<id>; the tool infers the root.

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of thread posts to return, default 50, max 100.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll rounds to load more thread posts, default 5, max 20.

returns.description: Object with ok, rootPostId, author, postCount, isThread, declaredParts and posts array.

get_history.description: Read the current account's History: all bookmarks, a bookmark folder, or likes.

maxItems.description: Maximum posts to return, default 50, max 100.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll rounds to load more, default 5, max 20.

returns.description: Object with ok, kind, itemCount, items and emptyState.

get_post_replies.description: Read the reply/comment list of an X post.

maxItems.description: Maximum replies to return, default 50, max 100.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll rounds to load more replies, default 5, max 20.

returns.description: Object with ok, rootPostId, rootAuthor, replyCount and replies array.

get_user_posts.description: Read posts authored by an X profile, restoring original text and expanding visible long-post controls before each extraction.

maxItems.description: Maximum posts to return, default 50, max 100.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll rounds to load more posts, default 60, max 120. Zero extracts only the first batch.

returns.description: Object with ok, username, itemCount, items, scrollRounds and stopReason. Items preserve paragraphs, visible metrics, media and checkedAt.

extract_profile_posts_report.description: Collect an X profile timeline in displayed order, including reposts and thread context, and return source-linked rows for CSV/Markdown reports. Only toggles Show original/Show more; never opens missing metrics or engages with posts.

username.description: X username, with or without @, or an X profile URL.

maxItems.description: Maximum unique displayed posts to record, default 50, max 100.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum scroll rounds, default 60, max 120. Zero extracts only the first batch.

returns.description: Object with ok, source_url, checked_at, access_status, posts_recorded, goal_reached, stop_reason, scroll_rounds and rows. Rows use visible counts or not displayed and flag remaining translated/truncated text with needs_review. Blocked runs retain previously captured rows.

get_user_replies.description: Read the replies list of an X user profile.

maxItems.description: Maximum replies to return, default 50, max 100.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll rounds to load more replies, default 5, max 20.

returns.description: Object with ok, username, itemCount and reply items with replyContext.

get_user_connections.description: Read a user's followers, verified followers, followers you know, or following list.

maxItems.description: Maximum users to return, default 50, max 100.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll rounds to load more users, default 5, max 20.

returns.description: Object with ok, username, kind, userCount, users and emptyState.

get_user_profile.description: Read an X user profile: name, handle, bio, location, website, join date, counts, avatar and tabs.

returns.description: Object with ok, profile and tabs.

post_from_active_element.description: Extract tweet data from the currently focused element in the timeline.

returns.description: Tweet text, author, timestamp.

extract_search_results.description: Extract post search results from the current X search page; returns login_required when the current profile is logged out.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of posts to return, default 20, max 100.

returns.description: Object with ok, query, url, resultCount and items array, or ok=false with reason=login_required.

extract_trends.description: Extract trending topics from the current X Explore page; returns login_required when logged out.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of trends to return, default 20, max 50.

returns.description: Object with ok, url, trendCount and trends array, or ok=false with reason=login_required.

extract_post_detail.description: Extract post detail from the current X post page; returns login_required when logged out.

returns.description: Object with ok, id, canonicalUrl, author, publishedAt, text, images, videos, cards and metrics.

extract_article.description: Extract X Article content from the current article page; returns login_required when logged out.

returns.description: Object with ok, articleId, title, author, publishedAt, contentText, blocks and images.

extract_thread.description: Extract the author's thread posts from the current X conversation page, inferring the root from the first conversation post.

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to return, default 50, max 100.

returns.description: Object with ok, rootPostId, author, postCount, isThread and posts array.

extract_timeline.description: Extract the visible post list from any X timeline page (bookmarks, likes, profile, replies).

maxItems.description: Maximum posts to return, default 50, max 100.

returns.description: Object with ok, itemCount, items and emptyState. Items retain paragraph text, links, visible reply/repost/like/view/quote/bookmark metrics, images, video posters, isTranslated and isTruncated. Missing metrics are empty strings. Does not click or navigate.

extract_replies.description: Extract the reply list from the current X conversation page.

maxItems.description: Maximum replies to return, default 50, max 100.

returns.description: Object with ok, rootPostId, rootAuthor, replyCount and replies.

extract_user_cells.description: Extract user cards from the current followers/following page.

maxItems.description: Maximum users to return, default 50, max 100.

returns.description: Object with ok, userCount, users and emptyState.

extract_profile.description: Extract an X profile header and tab list from the current profile page.

returns.description: Object with ok, profile and tabs.
